issue.usage:
usage: kander issue <command> [options]
       kander issue repo [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--json]
       kander issue list [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--state open|closed|all] [--label NAME] [--search TEXT] [--limit N] [--json]
       kander issue show NUMBER [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--comments] [--json]
       kander issue import NUMBER [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--comments] [--type feature|bug|chore|research] [--large] [--language LANG] [--json]
issue.error_no_remote: no GitHub remote was found in this repository
issue.error_insecure_remote: remote {{.V0}} embeds credentials; remove them before using the GitHub integration
issue.error_unsupported_host: a host with an explicit port is not supported: {{.V0}}
issue.error_unauthenticated: GitHub CLI is not authenticated for {{.V0}}
issue.error_not_found: repository not found or not accessible: {{.V0}}
issue.error_timeout: the GitHub CLI command timed out
issue.error_output_limit: the GitHub CLI command produced too much output
issue.remediation_repo_flag: pass --repo HOST/OWNER/REPO to select a repository explicitly
issue.remediation_set_default: or pick a default remote with `gh repo set-default HOST/OWNER/REPO`
tui.issues_hint: Enter detail  / search  Tab state  l label  i import/jump  I with comments  s hand off  r refresh  o browser  Esc close
tui.issues_detail_hint: Enter opens the selected issue with its comments
issue.error_not_an_issue: {{.V0}} is a pull request, not an issue
issue.remediation_issue_number: Use the issue number shown in the list.
issue.list_usage: usage: kander issue list [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--state open|closed|all] [--label NAME] [--search TEXT] [--limit N] [--json]
issue.show_usage: usage: kander issue show NUMBER [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--comments] [--json]
issue.import_usage: usage: kander issue import NUMBER [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--comments] [--type feature|bug|chore|research] [--large] [--language LANG] [--json]
issue.error_import_conflict: an existing card has an unreadable import snapshot: {{.V0}}
issue.remediation_reduce_scope: retry with a smaller scope: reduce --limit, drop --comments, or pick a smaller issue
issue.remediation_check_board: run `kander check` and repair that card, then retry
tui.import_issue: Import as card / jump to card
tui.handoff_issue: Hand off the issue into a running task
tui.handoff_edit_keys: ↑↓ field  ←→ value  Enter edit  Ctrl-S review  Esc cancel
tui.handoff_editor_keys: Esc save field  Tab next field  Ctrl-S review
tui.handoff_review_keys: ↑↓ row  Space attest  Enter edit  Ctrl-S save  Esc back
tui.handoff_confirm_keys: y confirm and start  n close
tui.handoff_undecided: ! TYPE and SIZE cannot be decided from the Issue; confirm both before the self-review.
tui.handoff_attest: I checked the four points above and confirm the contract
tui.handoff_review_item_1: Goal and outcome are consistent, no confirmed requirement is missing, and no suggestion or assumption is written as a user decision.
tui.handoff_review_item_2: The task boundary is clear, this round's scope and exclusions do not conflict, and work necessary to reach the goal is not excluded.
tui.handoff_review_item_3: Constraints are accurate and actionable, consistent with user decisions, project rules, and the actual interfaces and environment, with no contradictory requirements.
tui.handoff_review_item_4: ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA cover the goal and outcome, are actionable and decidable, and neither miss key conditions nor introduce out-of-scope requirements.
tui.handoff_conclusion_empty: (required; the tool never fills it in)
tui.handoff_attest_required: Attest the four self-review points before saving.
tui.handoff_conclusion_required: Write your own self-review conclusion before saving.
tui.handoff_conclusion_single_line: The conclusion is one line; it becomes a single SELF_REVIEW record.
tui.handoff_conclusion_structure: The conclusion carries no heading, metadata or record line.
tui.handoff_load_failed: The card could not be read: {{.V0}}
tui.handoff_conflict: Another write changed the card; your draft is kept and the revision was refreshed, so publishing again replaces the current card content.
tui.handoff_preview_failed: The start settings could not be resolved: {{.V0}}
tui.handoff_gate_review_hint: A large card or a task-group member needs an independent CARD_REVIEW record in DISCUSSION before it can enter todo; ask an independent agent to review the card, then reopen this form.
tui.handoff_gate_ready: Read-only gate check passed; confirming starts the card.
tui.handoff_retry_hint: The issue and its card are kept; reopen this form with s to retry.
tui.handoff_duplicate: Card {{.V0}} is already in {{.V1}}; this form only starts backlog cards.
tui.handoff_start_failed: The start failed: {{.V0}} The card is in {{.V1}}.
tui.handoff_unavailable: this build has no board binding
tui.handoff_type_invalid: TYPE must be one of feature, bug, chore or research.
tui.handoff_size_invalid: SIZE must be small or large.
tui.handoff_record_injected: The draft cannot add a record line: {{.V0}} is written by its own producer, not by this form.
tui.handoff_structure_field: {{.V0}} must not contain a heading, metadata line or record marker.
tui.handoff_acceptance_items: ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA needs at least one `- [ ]` item.
tui.handoff_source_required: GOAL must keep the requirement to read source/github-issue.md.
tui.handoff_language_fixed: LANGUAGE: {{.V0}} (fixed; cancel and re-import to change)
tui.handoff_retry_board: The card is no longer in backlog; start it from the board or `kander start`.
